definitions.explanation: A female monarch or the wife of a king; also used for queens of social insects.

examples.japanese: イギリスの{女王|じょおう}は{世界|せかい}で{最|もっと}も{有名|ゆうめい}な{王族|おうぞく}だ。
examples.english: The Queen of England is the most famous royalty in the world.

examples.japanese: {女王蜂|じょおうばち}は{巣|す}の{中心|ちゅうしん}にいる。
examples.english: The queen bee is at the center of the hive.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{美|び}の{女王|じょおう}と{呼|よ}ばれている。
examples.english: She is called the queen of beauty.

notes:
{女王|じょおう} refers to a queen regnant (ruling queen) or queen consort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女王|じょおう}{陛下|へいか} (Her Majesty the Queen)
- {女王蜂|じょおうばち} (queen bee)
- {女王蟻|じょおうあり} (queen ant)
- ...の{女王|じょおう} (queen of..., used figuratively)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女王|じょおう}: queen (ruling or married to king)
- {王女|おうじょ}: princess (daughter of a monarch)
- {女帝|じょてい}: empress (ruling female emperor)
- {皇后|こうごう}: empress consort (wife of emperor)
